new_candidates.body:
`OFKTStateSolver(scene_graph, prefix)` throws for any non-empty `prefix`. `initHelper` prefixes the root name, then looks the prefixed name up in the unprefixed scene graph:

```cpp
// state_solver/src/ofkt_state_solver.cpp (master e8d58a0090)
const auto root = LinkId(prefix + scene_graph.getRoot().name());                              // :1051
...
boost::visitor(builder).root_vertex(scene_graph.getVertex(root)).vertex_index_map(prop_index_map));  // :1073
```

The graph has no vertex named `prefix + root`, so `getVertex` throws (0.35.0, `ofkt_state_solver.cpp:1053`, `:1075`):

```text
SceneGraph, vertex with name 'r1_base_link' does not exist!
```

`insertSceneGraph` gets this right: it starts the search at `scene_graph.getVertex(scene_graph.getRoot())` (`:901`) and leaves the prefixing to `ofkt_builder`.

**Repro:** construct `OFKTStateSolver(graph, "r1_")` from any non-empty `SceneGraph`.

**Fix:** start the depth-first search at the unprefixed root, as `insertSceneGraph` does. Keep the prefixed `root` for `root_`, `link_map_` and `link_names_`:

```cpp
boost::visitor(builder).root_vertex(scene_graph.getVertex(scene_graph.getRoot())).vertex_index_map(prop_index_map));
```
